# Past The Label

> Every wine at three Northern Virginia shops — Arrowine (Arlington), The Wine Cabinet (Reston) and Winetonomy (online) — scored 0–100 for value: how much real wine you're getting for the price. ~3,133 bottles, updated every other day.

Past The Label rates the wine, not the label. The score rewards what's in the bottle (serious winemaking, real terroir, honest pricing) and docks bottles coasting on prestige. It is a conservative PREDICTION from each wine's credentials (producer, region, grape, vintage, price) — not a tasting note. Bands: 70+ Elite, 60–69 Strong, 50–59 Solid, under 50 Weak.

## Key pages
- [Full wine list](https://pastthelabel.com/wines.html): every bottle ranked by value (name, score, band, price, shop, region, stock) — the complete, lightweight catalogue.
- [All wines as JSON](https://pastthelabel.com/wines.json): the same full list as data, with our verdict for each bottle — for agents that want to filter or cite it.
- [How the score works](https://pastthelabel.com/how-it-works.html): the 100-point method (Quality + Edge + Value) in plain language.
- [Interactive catalogue](https://pastthelabel.com/): searchable, filterable dashboard (requires JavaScript).
- [Atom feed](https://pastthelabel.com/feed.xml): this week's top value picks.

## Notes
- Shops: Arrowine (Arlington, VA), The Wine Cabinet (Reston, VA) and Winetonomy (online-only, Reston, VA).
- Updated every other day. schema.org structured data (Product/Offer/Review + Dataset) on every page.
